load_env_file: load a dotenv file into os.environ and return the list of keys that were set
load_env_file_override: load a dotenv file into os.environ overriding existing values by passing override=True
load_env_file_blocked_keys: load a dotenv file that automatically ignores GAIA2_JUDGE_* keys and warns on stderr
review_load_env_file: review the load_env_file function to understand how it handles blocked dotenv keys and override behavior
refactor_load_env_file: refactor load_env_file to add support for custom blocked key sets beyond the default GAIA2_JUDGE_* keys
